name: video-business-1
note: Real examples of the video type: five clips made by HeyGen Video 1 (480p, 5 s, on the Vercel AI Gateway) and three made by Kybernos Motion (free, local). `request` is what the example's button puts in the composer; `made.prompt` is what the model was given for the sample. The clips and stills stay outside git (~/kybernos-archive/templates-catalogue/video-business-1).

entry.name: Product ad
entry.line: Your product photo, set in motion with its own sound.
entry.alt: A teal water bottle on a mossy rock beside a forest stream, in soft mist.

cells.request: Make a 5-second product ad video from my product photo. Ask me for the photo, the product name and a one-line tagline, and show me the first frame before you animate it.

made.label: HeyGen Video 1
made.prompt: Slow gentle push-in on the bottle resting on the mossy rock, water droplets glistening, a light mist drifting over the stream, the forest softly moving in the background, the sound of a gentle stream and soft acoustic guitar

entry.name: Virtual try-on
entry.line: The person wears the garment, turns and smiles to the camera.
entry.alt: A woman with dark curly hair in a mustard trench coat on a pale studio backdrop.

cells.request: Make a 5-second virtual try-on video. Ask me for a photo of the person, a photo of the garment and the colour I want. Show me the still result first, then animate it.

made.label: HeyGen Video 1
made.prompt: The woman slowly turns a quarter turn towards the camera and smiles, the trench coat swaying gently, soft studio ambience and light upbeat music

entry.name: Photo in a theme
entry.line: Your photo in a 90s, manga or space-opera look, then animated.
entry.alt: A young man in a denim jacket in front of a neon-lit 90s arcade at night.

cells.request: Turn my photo into a 5-second video in a theme I choose (the 90s, manga, space opera...). Ask me for the photo and the theme, show me the restyled still, then animate it.

made.label: HeyGen Video 1
made.prompt: The young man nods to the beat, neon sign flickering behind him with a subtle VHS glitch and scanlines, upbeat 90s synth music with a steady drum beat

entry.name: Property teaser
entry.line: A listing photo with a slow camera glide and a short caption.
entry.alt: A bright living room with a sofa and tall windows, seen from the doorway.

cells.request: Make a 5-second teaser video for a property listing. Ask me for the best photo of the property, the address and the price; add a slow camera glide and a short caption.

made.label: HeyGen Video 1
made.prompt: Slow smooth camera glide forward into the bright living room, sheer curtains moving gently in the breeze, soft daylight, quiet room tone

cells.source: image-to-video from the living-room still of images-business-1 (listing, 16:9)

entry.name: Vertical clip
entry.line: A 9:16 clip made from an idea, ready for social media.
entry.alt: A barista pouring steamed milk into a latte in a bright cafe.

cells.request: Make a 5-second vertical clip for social media from my idea. Ask me for the idea and the mood, and add captions.

made.label: HeyGen Video 1
made.prompt: A barista pours steamed milk into a latte in a bright cafe, slow close-up, warm morning light, soft cafe ambience

entry.name: Logo reveal
entry.line: Your logo animated in five seconds, with its sound.
entry.alt: An amber ring and dot above the word LUMO and a tagline, on a dark navy background.

cells.request: Animate my logo as a 5-second reveal. Ask me for the logo image and my brand colours.

entry.name: Results recap
entry.line: A table of figures turned into counting numbers and growing bars.
entry.alt: Three figure cards and a bar chart on a dark background, the last quarter highlighted.

cells.request: Turn my table of figures into a 10-second animated results video. Ask me for the table and which figure to highlight.

entry.name: Animated lesson
entry.line: One idea explained with a diagram, ending on a question.
entry.alt: A bar split in four with one quarter highlighted, and the sum 80 divided by 4 equals 20.

cells.request: Make a 10-second animated lesson that explains one idea with a diagram and ends with a question. Ask me for the topic and the level.
